apps.compose:
name: jellyfin
services:
  jellyfin:
    image: jellyfin/jellyfin:10.11.11
    restart: unless-stopped
    user: "${PUID:-1000}:${PGID:-1000}"
    security_opt:
      - no-new-privileges:true
    cap_drop:
      - ALL
    ports:
      - "8096:8096/tcp"
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: /DATA/AppData/jellyfin/config
        target: /config
      - type: bind
        source: /DATA/Media
        target: /media
        read_only: true
x-casaos:
  id: jellyfin
  version: "10.11.11"
  architectures:
    - amd64
    - arm64
  main: jellyfin
  author: AlcoIT Software
  category: Media
  description:
    en_us: Private media system.
    es_es: Sistema privado de contenido multimedia.
  developer: Jellyfin
  icon: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/IceWhaleTech/CasaOS-AppStore@main/Apps/Jellyfin/icon.png
  index: /
  port_map: "8096"
  scheme: http
  store_app_id: com.alcoit.jellyfin
  tagline:
    en_us: Your media, under your control.
    es_es: Tu contenido multimedia bajo tu control.
  title:
    en_us: Jellyfin
    es_es: Jellyfin
apps.name: Jellyfin

apps.compose:
name: pi-hole
services:
  pi-hole:
    image: pihole/pihole:2026.05.0
    restart: unless-stopped
    security_opt:
      - no-new-privileges:true
    cap_drop:
      - ALL
    cap_add:
      - NET_BIND_SERVICE
    ports:
      - "53:53/tcp"
      - "53:53/udp"
      - "8081:80/tcp"
    environment:
      TZ: "${TZ:-UTC}"
      FTLCONF_webserver_api_password: "${PIHOLE_PASSWORD:?Set PIHOLE_PASSWORD}"
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: /DATA/AppData/pi-hole/etc-pihole
        target: /etc/pihole
x-casaos:
  id: pi-hole
  version: "2026.05.0"
  architectures:
    - amd64
    - arm64
  main: pi-hole
  author: AlcoIT Software
  category: Network
  description:
    en_us: Network-wide DNS filtering.
    es_es: Filtrado DNS para toda la red.
  developer: Pi-hole
  icon: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/IceWhaleTech/CasaOS-AppStore@main/Apps/Pi-hole/icon.png
  index: /admin
  port_map: "8081"
  scheme: http
  store_app_id: com.alcoit.pihole
  tagline:
    en_us: Network-wide ad blocking.
    es_es: Bloqueo de publicidad para toda la red.
  title:
    en_us: Pi-hole
    es_es: Pi-hole
apps.name: Pi-hole
